person.name: Jon Best
person.text: Jon is **Director, Business Development & Market Strategies** at AbbVie (since Jan 2019, per public profile; title also in Streak). Before that: **Senior Manager Sales at Lonza** (2015-2019), **Manager BD at Helsinn** (2011-2015), Senior Manager BD at Ferro-Pfanstiehl, VP Marketing & Sales at Rohner, and a long first chapter at **Abbott** (1995-2007, contract marketing then BD), which is where AbbVie's CMO business came from. MBA from Lake Forest Graduate School of Management; BA from the University of Northern Iowa. Based in **Atlanta** (public profile). On the call he mentioned team planning meetings in **Dublin** (AbbVie has CMO BD roles in Ireland).

company.text: AbbVie Contract Manufacturing is the CDMO arm of AbbVie, based in **North Chicago, Illinois**. It offers custom **API and bulk manufacturing**, **biologics** (incl. monoclonal antibodies), **aseptic fill-finish** (vials, prefilled syringes), **oral solid dose**, **hot melt extrusion**, potent compound handling, packaging and eye care. It runs **11 production facilities** in North America and Europe and stresses an "embedded CMO" model with access to AbbVie scientists. It is hiring BD managers in Dublin and Italy (Campoverde), a sign it is pushing to grow third-party revenue.

AbbVie has announced several US manufacturing investments (API capacity in North Chicago; biologics in Singapore), amounts **to be confirmed**.

history.text: Aina booked a video call for **Jul 21, 2026** (Jon used a personal Gmail). The call happened after some camera trouble. On **Jul 22** Olivier sent a recap: reposition the CMO with small/mid biotechs; "We do not sell. We make sure they want to buy."; 10 qualified meetings/month for **$3,400/month** (3-month minimum); lift SSI from 52 to 70s; 100 invitations a week; campaign run outside Salesforce, leads handed over at meeting stage. A follow-up was proposed for **Aug 11** after Jon's Dublin meetings. **No reply** from Jon is logged and no Aug 11 meeting was found. On **Oct 18** Olivier sent the new-website email (no open recorded).

industry.title: CDMO demand rebounding
industry.text: Biotech funding and outsourcing are recovering; emerging biotechs outsource most manufacturing.

industry.title: Onshoring and tariffs
industry.text: US tariffs and the BIOSECURE debate push biotechs toward US and EU suppliers, away from some Asian CDMOs.

industry.title: Big-pharma CDMOs fight perception
industry.text: Pharma-owned CMOs are often seen as filling spare capacity; they must prove long-term commitment.

industry.title: Events drive deals
industry.text: BIO International, CPHI and DCAT are where CDMO BD teams meet buyers.
